title: Public reaction send response (PRF-02 slice 6 / PRF-06)
description: The 201 body returned when a reaction is recorded from the public tip page. It carries the outcome and nothing else: no reaction id, no viewer id, no anonymous identity token, no session id, no channel id and no timestamp. Nothing here is addressable afterwards, because a viewer has nothing to address -- a reaction is not a record a viewer owns, reads back, edits or deletes. Rejections use the shared error envelope instead: 429 reaction_rate_limited when THIS SENDER has reached 60 sends inside the current one-minute window (the limit is per sender, never per channel, so a creator's throughput scales with their audience), 400 reaction_sender_unidentified when no sender identity can be resolved -- refused rather than accepted or downgraded to a weaker limit, 400 unknown_reaction_entry, 403 reaction_entry_not_available, 403 bot_verification_required, 404 not_found, 503 reaction_unavailable.
